biological_replicate: The raw data were obtained from three biological replicates for each strain, were processed using Proteome Discoverer 2.4.0.305 software (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc., Waltham, MA, USA), and searched against the ToxoDB-46_TgondiiME49 database.
experimental_design: label-free quantitation, with data-dependent acquisition, with the protein ratio calculation obtained from a pairwise ratio-based approach; and a Top3 quantification, with the protein ratio calculation obtained from a protein abundance-based approach

Two quantification methods were considered: label-free quantification, with data-dependent acquisition, with the protein ratio calculation obtained from a pairwise ratio-based approach; and a Top3 quantification, with the protein ratio calculation obtained from a protein abundance-based approach, in which the calculation of protein abundances was based on the sum of the three most abundant peptides.
number_of_biological_replicates: The raw data were obtained from three biological replicates for each strain, were processed using Proteome Discoverer 2.4.0.305 software (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc., Waltham, MA, USA), and searched against the ToxoDB-46_TgondiiME49 database.
technology_type: Protein identification and quantitation were performed by nanoLC-MS/MS.
